Fatigue behavior of highly porous titanium produced by powder metallurgy with temporary space holders

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Transferable Skim only mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Sedat Özbilen, Daniela Liebert, Tilmann Beck, Martin Bram Materials Science and Engineering C 2015-12-01 10.1016/j.msec.2015.11.050
单位: Forschungszentrum Jülich, Institute of Energy and Climate Research (IEK), 52425 Jülich, Germany; Gazi University, Faculty of Technology, Department of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, Teknikok
通讯: Martin Bram @ Forschungszentrum Jülich, Institute of Energy and Climate Research (IEK), 52425 Jülich, Germany. Electronic address: m.b
相关性: 该论文研究了多孔钛的疲劳行为，但制造方法为粉末冶金而非LPBF，且未涉及应力屏蔽或骨整合。
边界: This paper uses powder metallurgy with space holders, not LPBF, and does not address stress shielding, stiffness matching, or osseointegration.
动机· 研究多孔钛的疲劳行为以评估其在承重植入物中的适用性。
方法· 采用粉末冶金与临时空间支架法制备多孔钛，并进行疲劳测试。
结果· 多孔钛的疲劳强度随孔隙率增加而降低，但高孔隙率样品仍表现出可接受的疲劳寿命。
验证· 通过力学测试验证疲劳性能，并与文献数据对比。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the fatigue behavior of highly porous titanium for potential load-bearing implant applications.
Method· Porous titanium was fabricated via powder metallurgy with temporary space holders and subjected to fatigue testing.
Result· Fatigue strength decreased with increasing porosity, but high-porosity samples still exhibited acceptable fatigue life.
Validation· Mechanical testing validated fatigue performance, with comparisons to literature data.
porous titanium · 多孔钛fatigue behavior · 疲劳行为powder metallurgy · 粉末冶金space holder · 空间支架mechanical testing · 力学测试
porous titanium fatigue powder metallurgy space holder mechanical testing

Osteoblast functions in functionally graded Ti-6Al-4 V mesh structures

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Direct Save for project in_vitro Exp. validation
KC Nune, Alok Kumar, R.D.K. Misra, SJ Li, YL Hao et al. Journal of Biomaterials Applications 2015-12-01 10.1177/0885328215617868
单位: Biomedical Engineering The University of Texas at El Paso, 500 W. University Avenue, El Paso, Texas, USA
通讯: R.D.K. Misra @ Biomedical Engineering The University of Texas at El Paso, 500 W. University Avenue, El Paso, Texas, USA
相关性: 该论文研究了功能梯度Ti-6Al-4V网状结构对成骨细胞功能的影响，与用户关注的AM生物医学植入物方向相关，但缺乏应力遮挡和疲劳性能分析。
边界: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, stiffness matching, or fatigue behavior; it focuses on in vitro cellular response without mechanical testing or as-built surface characterization.
动机· 探究功能梯度网状结构对成骨细胞功能的调控作用
方法· 制备Ti-6Al-4V功能梯度与均匀网状结构，接种前成骨细胞进行体外培养
结果· 梯度结构从大孔侧接种促进细胞附着、增殖和矿化，优于均匀结构
验证· 通过免疫荧光染色和矿化分析验证细胞行为
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To elucidate the influence of functionally graded Ti-6Al-4V mesh architectures on osteoblast functions for bone defect treatment.
Method· Functionally graded and uniform mesh arrays were fabricated via additive manufacturing, seeded with pre-osteoblasts, and assessed for attachment, proliferation, and mineralization.
Result· Graded structures seeded from the large pore side enhanced cell adhesion, proliferation, and mineralization compared to uniform and non-porous controls.
Validation· Cellular responses were validated via immunofluorescence staining for actin and vinculin, and mineralization assays.

A general framework for experimental design, uncertainty quantification and sensitivity analysis of computer simulation models

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project simulation_case UQ
Sichao Wu, Henning S. Mortveit 2015 Winter Simulation Conference (WSC) 2015-12-01 10.1109/wsc.2015.7408240
单位: VBI, Virginia Tech, Blacksburg, VA, USA
通讯: Sichao Wu @ VBI, Virginia Tech, Blacksburg, VA, USA
相关性: 该论文提出了一个通用的实验设计、不确定度量化与敏感性分析框架，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的构建与验证。
边界: This paper does not apply the framework to FEA surrogate modeling or implant biomechanics; it is a general methodology paper without domain-specific validation.
动机· 计算机仿真模型的实验设计、UQ和SA缺乏标准化框架，非专家难以执行。
方法· 提出一个领域无关的通用框架，透明处理数据管理和模型执行。
结果· 框架支持高效的实验设计和UQ/SA，并通过应用示例展示其可用性。
验证· 通过一个应用示例进行概念验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Rigorous design of experiments, uncertainty quantification, and sensitivity analysis for computer simulation models are hindered by lack of standardization and ease of use.
Method· A domain- and model-independent framework is proposed that transparently handles data management and model execution, allowing users to focus on analysis.
Result· The framework enables efficient experimental design and UQ/SA, demonstrated through an application example.
Validation· Validation is performed via a single application example illustrating the framework's concepts and basic use.

动机· 在工程设计中平衡高保真模型的精度与低保真模型的效率。
方法· 提出基于Kriging缩放函数的主动学习变保真度元建模方法，迭代构建代理模型。

Motivation· To balance accuracy and computational cost in engineering design by integrating low- and high-fidelity models.
Method· An active learning variable-fidelity metamodeling approach using a Kriging scaling function is proposed, transforming one-shot modeling into an iterative process.
Result· The approach demonstrates applicability on a nonlinear numerical case and a long cylinder pressure vessel optimization problem.
Validation· Validation is performed through an analytic numerical case and an engineering design optimization problem.

Farshid Rezaei, Kamran Hassani, Nosratollah Solhjoei, Alireza Karimi Australasian physical & engineering sciences in medicine 2015-12-01 10.1007/s13246-015-0380-3
相关性: 该论文通过有限元分析比较碳/聚醚醚酮复合材料与金属假体的应力遮挡效应，直接相关于髋关节植入物的力学性能评估。
边界: It does not report micromotion, lacks patient-specific geometry, and has no experimental validation.
动机· 评估碳/聚醚醚酮复合材料假体在减少应力遮挡方面的潜力。
方法· 采用有限元模拟比较碳/聚醚醚酮与不锈钢/钛合金假体的载荷传递。
结果· 碳/聚醚醚酮假体应力应变显著降低，载荷传递更均匀。

Motivation· To evaluate the potential of carbon/PEEK composite prostheses in reducing stress shielding compared to conventional metal implants.
Method· A comparative finite element simulation was conducted to assess load transfer and stress distribution in femoral prostheses made of carbon/PEEK, stainless steel, and titanium alloy.
Result· Carbon/PEEK prostheses exhibited significantly lower von Mises stress and strain, with a more uniform load transfer to the femur.
Validation· The study is purely computational with no experimental validation.

Bone Remodelling in the Proximal Femur after Uncemented Total Hip Arthroplasty in Patients with Osteoporosis

Marek Lacko, D. Schreierová, R. ČELLÁR, G Vaško Acta chirurgiae orthopaedicae et traumatologiae Cechoslovaca 2015-12-01 10.55095/achot2015/071
单位: pohybového ústrojenstva LF UPJŠ Trieda SNP č.1 04011 Košice, Slovenská republika
通讯: Marek Lacko @ pohybového ústrojenstva LF UPJŠ Trieda SNP č.1 04011 Košice, Slovenská republika
相关性: 该论文直接研究了骨质疏松患者非骨水泥全髋置换术后股骨近端骨密度变化，与用户关注的应力遮挡和骨重塑相关。
边界: This paper does not include finite element modeling, stress/strain quantification, or micromotion analysis; it is a clinical densitometry study without biomechanical simulation.
动机· 探究骨质疏松对非骨水泥全髋置换后股骨近端骨重塑的影响及双膦酸盐治疗的效果。
方法· 将60例患者分为骨质疏松治疗组、未治疗组和正常骨密度组，术后12个月测量Gruen区骨密度。
结果· 未治疗骨质疏松组骨密度下降最显著，治疗组与正常组无显著差异，临床结果最差。
验证· 临床患者分组对照，DEXA测量骨密度，Harris评分评估临床状态。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the role of osteoporosis in proximal femoral bone remodeling after uncemented THA and the effect of bisphosphonate treatment.
Method· Sixty patients were divided into three groups based on preoperative bone density: osteoporotic with zoledronic acid, osteoporotic untreated, and normal density; BMD in seven Gruen zones was measured at 12 months.
Result· Untreated osteoporotic patients showed the greatest BMD loss, with significant differences in zones 1,2,6,7 compared to normal density group, while treated patients had no significant difference.
Validation· Clinical prospective study with DEXA densitometry and Harris hip score, comparing three patient groups.

动机· 研究不同阳极氧化微形貌对钛表面耐腐蚀性的影响。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate how different anodized microtopographies affect the corrosion resistance of titanium surfaces for biomedical applications.
Method· Pure titanium substrates were anodized to produce porous films with micron, submicron, and combined scales, then characterized by surface morphology, crystallinity, and roughness, followed by electrochemical testing in simulated body fluid.

Motivation· To assess the presence of nestin-expressing osteogenic progenitor cells in the human Schneiderian membrane, as their role in bone formation and osseointegration was not previously characterized.
Method· Immunohistochemistry was performed on paraffin-embedded tissue samples from eight adult patients using antibodies against nestin, CD45, CD146, cytokeratin 7, and alpha-smooth muscle actin.
Result· Nestin was consistently expressed in endothelial cells and occasionally in pericytes and putative stromal stem/progenitor cells, with woven bone formation observed in the periosteal layer.

Motivation· To measure the thermal expansion coefficient of SLM-fabricated Co-Cr alloy for dental porcelain compatibility.

Motivation· To compare the biomechanical characteristics of five internal fixation methods for stabilizing pubic symphysis diastasis.

Motivation· To investigate whether a multimodal perioperative care protocol combined with preoperative immune nutrition improves recovery after total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A randomized pilot study comparing the ACERTO protocol (shortened fasting, carbohydrate drink, restricted fluids, immune nutrition) with traditional care in 32 patients.

相关性: 该论文关注髋臼重建后的移植物整合评估，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或微动分析。
边界: No quantification of proximal femur stress/strain, no micromotion modeling, no intact vs implanted femur comparison, and no patient-specific FE boundary conditions.
动机· 比较X线与MDCT在评估髋臼重建后移植物整合中的准确性。
方法· 回顾11例髋臼重建患者，分别用X线和MDCT评估移植物整合。
结果· MDCT比X线更准确，仅1例完全整合，X线则显示全部整合。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare the accuracy of radiography and multidetector computed tomography in assessing graft integration after acetabular reconstruction.
Method· A retrospective review of 11 patients who underwent acetabular reconstruction with structural allografts, evaluated by both radiography and MDCT.
Result· MDCT revealed complete graft integration in only one patient, whereas radiography indicated integration in all patients, demonstrating MDCT's superior accuracy.
Validation· Clinical follow-up with a mean of 4.2 years and reoperation rate as survival endpoint.

Motivation· To evaluate the clinical outcomes of total hip arthroplasty in elderly patients with coxarthrosis.

Method· A two-stage revision arthroplasty approach combined with long-term ertapenem therapy was employed.
Result· Final intra-articular cultures were negative, ESR and CRP normalized, and the patient was pain-free with good range of motion at 5-month follow-up.
Validation· Clinical outcomes and laboratory markers (ESR, CRP, cultures) were used to validate treatment efficacy.

相关性: 该论文研究抗生素在关节置换术中的骨渗透，不涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或微动分析。
边界: This paper focuses on antibiotic pharmacokinetics in arthroplasty, with no biomechanical modeling, implant stress shielding, micromotion, or contact mechanics.
动机· 研究氟氯西林和庆大霉素在髋膝关节置换术中的骨渗透效果。
方法· 收集21例TKA和18例THA患者骨样本，用高效液相色谱分析抗生素浓度。
结果· 庆大霉素骨渗透高于氟氯西林，髋臼浓度高于股骨头颈；TKA中渗透低于THA。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the bone penetration of flucloxacillin and gentamicin during hip and knee arthroplasty and their efficacy against common pathogens.
Method· Bone samples from 21 TKA and 18 THA patients were analyzed using high-performance liquid chromatography to measure antibiotic concentrations.
Result· Gentamicin showed higher bone penetration than flucloxacillin; acetabular concentrations were higher than femoral head/neck, and penetration was lower in TKA than THA.
Validation· Clinical bone sample measurements compared against epidemiological cut-off values for resistance.

动机· 评估钽金属块重建Paprosky III型严重髋臼骨缺损的短期效果。

Motivation· To evaluate the short-term clinical outcomes of tantalum metal blocks for reconstructing Paprosky type III severe acetabular bone defects in revision total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A retrospective analysis of 12 patients (12 hips) treated with tantalum metal blocks combined with large-diameter biological acetabular cups.
Result· Harris hip scores improved significantly from preoperative (46.25±8.99) to postoperative (83.75±6.76), with excellent/good results in 9 of 11 followed-up cases.

Motivation· To evaluate whether preoperative antibiotic prophylaxis affects intraoperative culture results in suspected or confirmed prosthetic joint infections.
